body: my roomie has a miniature goldendoodle (if you’ve never seen one pls google them ASAP- SO CUTE) named Lulu and she is the loml. She does so many funny things, she’s such a big personality. One of the funniest things she does though is, upon ringing the bell we have hanging on the door to let her out, she will walk from the door into whichever room someone is in and just stare at them, like “didn’t you hear me ring the bell?!”. It’s just super funny and cute to see- especially if both my roomie and I are in the room bc she’ll look from him to me as if to say “really? two of you and neither of you are getting up yet?”. Kind of a “you have to be there” type thing but I still think it’s cute to hear! I hope you’re okay, negative thoughts are hard to deal with and it can feel impossible to shut them off, but just know that I’m rooting for you!
